import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] Comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] B = new long[32][32];
    static long totalPaths;
    static int R, C, n;
    static char[] path;
    static long[][][] cnt = new long[32][32];
    static long minDiff;
    static Vector<long[]>[][] upPath = new Vector[32][2];
    static Vector<long[]>[][] downPath = new Vector[32][2];
    static long result;

    static void recordPaths(int x, int y, long gain, long c1, long c2, boolean dir) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            upPath[x][dir ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{gain, c1});
            if (c2 != 0) {
                downPath[x][dir ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{gain, c2});
            }
            return;
        }
        recordPaths(x+1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x+1][y] : 0), c1, (path[x+y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), dir);
        recordPaths(x, y+1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y+1] : 0), c1, (path[x+y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), dir);
    }

    static void searchForward(int x, int y, long gain, boolean dir) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            if (upPath[x][dir ? 1 : 0].isEmpty()) return;
            long target = (totalPaths + 1) / 2 - gain;
            Vector<long[]> vec = upPath[x][dir ? 1 : 0];
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(vec, new long[]{target, 0}, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            for (int offset = 0; offset < 2; ++offset) {
                int j = idx - offset;
                if (j >= 0 && j < vec.size() && vec.get(j)[1] > 0) {
                    long diff = Math.abs((vec.get(j)[0] + gain) * 2 - totalPaths);
                    if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0) searchForward(x-1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x][y] : 0), dir);
        if (y > 0) searchForward(x, y-1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y] : 0), dir);
    }

    static void searchBackward(int x, int y, long gain, boolean dir) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            Vector<long[]> vec = downPath[x][dir ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (totalPaths + 1) / 2 - gain;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(vec, new long[]{target, 0}, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            for (int offset = 0; offset < 2; ++offset) {
                int j = idx - offset;
                if (j >= 0 && j < vec.size() && vec.get(j)[1] > 0) {
                    long diff = Math.abs((vec.get(j)[0] + gain) * 2 - totalPaths);
                    if (diff == minDiff) result += vec.get(j)[1];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > 0 && path[x+y-1] != 'B') searchBackward(x-1, y, gain + (!dir ? A[x][y] : 0), dir);
        if (y > 0 && path[x+y-1] != 'A') searchBackward(x, y-1, gain + (dir ? B[x][y] : 0), dir);
    }

    static void compress(Vector<long[]> vec) {
        if (vec.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(vec, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
        int k = 0;
        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
            sum += vec.get(i)[1];
            if (i == vec.size() - 1 || vec.get(i)[0] != vec.get(i+1)[0]) {
                vec.set(k, new long[]{vec.get(i)[0], sum});
                k++;
            }
        }
        while (vec.size() > k) {
            vec.remove(vec.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        path = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            Comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                Comb[i][j] = Comb[i-1][j-1] + Comb[i-1][j];
        }
        
        n = R + C;
        totalPaths = Comb[n*2][R*2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (i != 0) A[i][j] = Comb[i-1][R-1] * (Comb[n*2-i][R] - Comb[j][R]);
                if (j != 0) B[i][j] = Comb[j-1][R-1] * (Comb[n*2-j][R] - Comb[i][R]);
            }
        
        cnt[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (i != n && path[i+j] != 'B') cnt[i+1][j] += cnt[i][j];
                if (j != n && path[i+j] != 'A') cnt[i][j+1] += cnt[i][j];
            }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                upPath[i][j] = new Vector<>();
                downPath[i][j] = new Vector<>();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (path[i+R-1] != 'B') recordPaths(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], cnt[R-1][i], false);
            if (path[i+R-1] != 'A') recordPaths(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], cnt[i][R-1], true);
        }
        
        for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int d = 0; d < 2; ++d) {
                compress(upPath[i][d]);
                compress(downPath[i][d]);
            }
        
        minDiff = totalPaths + 1;
        result = 0;
        searchForward(n, n, 0, false);
        searchForward(n, n, 0, true);
        searchBackward(n, n, 0, false);
        searchBackward(n, n, 0, true);
        
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
